items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Cordon Jenkins, for instance, who had been arranging for the Jones band when we were with him contributed because he knew we didn't have any bread, wrote some things for us

ctx.x: And then, we had a lot of outside contributors,

well, people who were really not outside, because Cordon Jenkins, for instance, who had been arranging for the Jones band when we were with him contributed because he knew we didn't have any bread, wrote some things for us, and this helped us. And a lot of good writers -- and James Noble wrote for the band for quite a while, and later, Nick Harper -- Harper is his original name -- a fiddle player. He wrote a lot of music for the band, and a lot of it was very different. He wrote a swinging arrangement of…
Were you in some way pulling things together from the variety of contributors to fit the direction that you had? Did you edit things then?
